MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Buon Natale: The Christmas Album felt like a natural next choice because Christmas music is the clearest recurring interest in my history.",
    "Its explicit Christmas theme gave me a concrete reason to try an unfamiliar album during one of my infrequent listening sessions."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Tony Bennett piano tribute and the Willie Nelson collection did not connect clearly to the Christmas listening I have repeated.",
    "A gospel collection does not automatically fit my interest in Christmas music; those are different reasons for choosing an album.",
    "Titles such as Uncharted and Under the Influence gave me no clear musical connection to my history, so I would skip them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The list seemed to assume that an interest in Christmas albums also meant an interest in gospel or other traditional-sounding collections.",
    "It seemed to treat familiar performers and collections of hits as sufficient reasons for me to listen, although my history does not establish those preferences."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I chose several Christmas albums and returned to The Classic Christmas Album, making that theme more convincing than a broad interest in music.",
    "Those Christmas choices happened close together in November 2014, while my later interaction was The New Old Fashioned; I would welcome a Christmas suggestion without assuming it explains all my current listening.",
    "Because I listen infrequently, I need a clear connection to an established interest before trying something unfamiliar."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The Christmas recommendation matched a repeated interest, but most of the list extended that interest to music I have little reason to choose."
}
